text: Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus for at least 6 months before screening, with HbA1c between 7.0% and 10.5% at screening

Adults with moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis fulfilling the 2010 ACR/EULAR classification criteria, with at least 6 swollen and 6 tender joints

Patients with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer confirmed by IHC 3+ or ISH amplification at a central laboratory

Paroxysmal, persistent or permanent non-valvular atrial fibrillation documented by 12-lead ECG or Holter monitoring within the last 12 months
Essential hypertension with mean seated systolic blood pressure ≥ 140 mmHg and < 180 mmHg at screening despite treatment with at least two antihypertensive agents
Chronic plaque psoriasis for at least 6 months with PASI ≥ 12, BSA ≥ 10% and sPGA ≥ 3 at baseline
Relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis per the 2017 revised McDonald criteria, with an EDSS score of 0 to 5.5 at screening
Diagnosis of COPD for at least 12 months with post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC < 0.70 and FEV1 30% to 80% of predicted
Chronic hepatitis B infection, defined as HBsAg positive for at least 6 months, with HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL at screening
Moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis with a modified Mayo score of 5 to 9 and an endoscopic subscore of ≥ 2 confirmed by central reading
Primary diagnosis of major depressive disorder, single or recurrent episode, according to DSM-5 criteria, with a MADRS total score ≥ 26 at screening and baseline
Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer with progression on prior androgen receptor pathway inhibitor and serum testosterone < 50 ng/dL
Physician-diagnosed asthma for at least 12 months requiring medium- to high-dose inhaled corticosteroids plus a second controller medication
Chronic atopic dermatitis present for at least 3 years before the screening visit, with EASI ≥ 16 and IGA ≥ 3 at baseline
Histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the colon or rectum with unresectable metastatic disease and RAS wild-type tumour status
Postmenopausal women with osteoporosis, defined as a BMD T-score ≤ -2.5 at the lumbar spine, total hip or femoral neck measured by DXA
Hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosed histologically or by AASLD radiological criteria, BCLC stage B or C, with Child-Pugh class A liver function
Idiopathic Parkinson's disease diagnosed according to the MDS clinical diagnostic criteria, Hoehn and Yahr stage 1 to 3 in the ON state
Relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma after at least two lines of systemic therapy, including an anti-CD20 antibody and an anthracycline
Systemic lupus erythematosus fulfilling the 2019 EULAR/ACR classification criteria with a SLEDAI-2K score ≥ 6 at screening
Obesity with a BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2, or BMI ≥ 27 kg/m2 with at least one weight-related comorbidity, at the screening visit
Migraine with or without aura for at least 12 months according to ICHD-3, with 4 to 14 migraine days per month during the baseline period
Gout meeting the 2015 ACR/EULAR classification criteria with serum urate ≥ 8.0 mg/dL and at least 2 flares in the previous 12 months
Documented coronary artery disease with ≥ 50% stenosis in at least one major epicardial vessel on invasive coronary angiography
High-grade serous epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer, FIGO stage III or IV, newly diagnosed
Crohn's disease of the ileum and/or colon for at least 3 months, confirmed by endoscopy and histology, with CDAI 220 to 450
Newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukaemia per WHO 2016 classification with FLT3 mutation (ITD or TKD) detected by a validated assay
Pulmonary arterial hypertension confirmed by right heart catheterisation with mPAP > 20 mmHg, PVR > 2 Wood units and PAWP ≤ 15 mmHg
On a stable dose of metformin ≥ 1500 mg/day for at least 8 weeks prior to screening
Recipient of a first kidney transplant from a living or deceased donor at least 6 months before enrolment
Focal epilepsy diagnosed at least 2 years ago, with ≥ 4 focal seizures per 28 days during the 8-week baseline despite 1 to 3 antiseizure medications
